Name: Pelican Stories
Author: PanKoziolek
Description:
[center][size=5][b][color=#D9A441]PELICAN STORIES[/color][/b][/size]
[i]A Vanilla-Style Story Expansion[/i]

[b]252 connected chapters for 21 residents — and a town that remembers what you do.[/b]

[color=#E0A82E][b]FIRST PUBLIC BETA[/b][/color]  •  English + Polish  •  Stardew Valley 1.6[/center]


[color=#D9A441][b]✦ ABOUT[/b][/color]

Pelican Stories expands the lives of 21 existing Pelican Town residents through connected storylines designed to fit naturally beside Stardew Valley's original tone.

Chapters begin through letters or by visiting eligible locations. Completed stories continue to matter through later conversations, town reactions, follow-up letters, ambient scenes, festivals, and lasting changes around the valley.


[color=#D9A441][b]✦ FEATURES[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][b]252 sequential story chapters[/b] — 12 for each resident.[/*]
[*][b]2,016 additional dialogue lines[/b] [/*]
[*]Persistent NPC memory and relationship-aware conversations.[/*]
[*][b]42 optional decisions[/b] with later dialogue and visual consequences.[/*]
[*]Town reactions, delayed letters, ambient scenes, festival follow-ups, map markers, and six shared epilogues.[/*]
[*]Full [b]English and Polish[/b] translations.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#D9A441][b]✦ NATURAL PROGRESSION[/b][/color]

Every resident's chapters must be completed in order, and Pelican Stories never completes objectives automatically.

[color=#D9A441][b]✦ REQUIREMENTS[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 on PC.[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.x[/url].[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49382]Accord Settings 0.1.9-beta.1 or newer[/url] — [b]required[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[color=#D9A441][b]✦ INSTALLATION[/b][/color]

[list=1]
[*]Back up an important save.[/*]
[*]Install SMAPI and Accord Settings.[/*]
[*]Extract the [b]PelicanStories[/b] folder directly into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#D9A441][b]✦ BETA NOTICE[/b][/color]

This first beta has passed static validation, a clean Release build, and a SMAPI loading test. The complete hands-on gameplay, map-mod, multiplayer, and split-screen test matrix is still in progress.

[b]Please back up important saves before installing.[/b]
[center][/center]
